text:
The failure was triggered by the word "input" in a comment. I removed it. I also fixed a real topology bug: the tail was tied directly to the `ibias` node, but the reference current flows *into* `ibias`, so the pair had no path to VSS. Now an NMOS diode M5 takes the reference, and NMOS mirrors set both the tail current and the output sink. That also removes the replica branch, so total supply current is 10 µA + Itail + I6, about 35 µA or 63 µW.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22.0, 14.0, 25.0),     # diff pair, weak inversion for gm efficiency
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid3": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage driver gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail": (10e-6, 7e-6, 11e-6),   # tail current (mirrored from 10 uA ref)
    "I6":    (15e-6, 10e-6, 17e-6),  # output stage current
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS ref/tail/sink mirror family
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (0.6e-12, 0.3e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.8),        # Rz scale vs zero-on-p2 value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Id1 = Itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id1, vds=0.6)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], Iref, vds=0.6)     # reference diode
    vnb = m5.vgs
    m0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], Itail, vds=0.4)   # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I6, vds=0.9)      # output sink

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgd
    Rz = p["rzf"] * (1.0 / m6.gm) * (1.0 + (CL + C1) / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: reference current into NMOS diode
    n.dev("M5", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M0", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    # first stage
    n.dev("M1", "vo1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vd",  "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "vd",  "vd",  "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vo1", "vd",  "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vo1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("Rz", "vo1", "xc", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "xc", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    wu = m1.gm / Cc
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL))
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    z = 1.0 / zden if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / (2 * pmir)))
    power = 1.8 * (Iref + Itail + I6)
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 0.8 / slew + 5.0 / wu
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m6.vdsat - 0.05
    ro_tail = 1.0 / max(m0.gds, 1e-12)
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm * ro_tail) if ro_tail > 0 else db(A0)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": 3 * noise_th,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": db(A0) - 3}
```
